outlook.statement: The fruit industry is globally on the rise, and we expect the same to continue to grow, based on the health parameters and fruit demand. This is an opportunity to produce and sell more.

risks: Agriculture is fraught with the risk of vagaries of monsoon. Although we have catered for additional water sourcing from the Paithan Dam, through a dedicated pipeline, the threat due to low and no-rain cannot be ruled out.
The main risk in the agriculture business is the vagaries of monsoon.
